becomeAHost.whyHostSubtitle: Join thousands of hosts who earn extra income while sharing their unique spaces with travelers from around the world.
becomeAHost.feature1Desc: Set your own prices, availability, and house rules. You decide who can book.
becomeAHost.feature2Desc: Host Guarantee program, secure deposits, and 24/7 dedicated support for hosts. Host with confidence.
becomeAHost.feature3Desc: We charge 0% commission to hosts — you keep every penny of your nightly earnings. Guests pay a simple 5% service fee on top of your price. Your cleaning fee always passes through in full.
becomeAHost.commissionDesc1: Most platforms take 15–25% from hosts. Oikivo charges
becomeAHost.commissionDesc2: to hosts — you keep 100% of your nightly price. Your cleaning fee always passes through in full. Only guests pay a 5% service fee.
becomeAHost.earnTitle: See how much you could earn
becomeAHost.earnDesc: Hosts in your area typically earn $2,500 - $4,500 per month. Your earnings depend on your location, listing type, and how often you host.
becomeAHost.readyDesc: It only takes 10 minutes to set up your listing. We'll guide you through every step.
becomeAHost.faq1Q: How much does it cost to list my place?
becomeAHost.faq1A: Listing your place is completely free. Oikivo charges 0% commission to hosts — you keep 100% of your nightly price. Your cleaning fee is always passed through in full. Guests pay a separate 5% service fee on top of your listed price.
becomeAHost.faq2A: Payments are released 24 hours after guest check-in and deposited directly to your bank or PayPal.
becomeAHost.faq3A: Our Host Guarantee Program supports you in damage disputes. You can require a security deposit from guests (collected and held securely by Oikivo), and our support team mediates any claims with photos and documentation.
becomeAHost.faq4Q: Can I host if I rent my place?
becomeAHost.faq4A: It depends on your lease and local laws. Check with your landlord and local regulations first.
becomeAHost.ctaDesc: Join our community of hosts and start earning from your extra space. Setup takes less than 10 minutes.

help.cat1Q1: How do I create a listing?
help.cat1A1: Go to Dashboard → Hosting → Create Listing. Fill in your property details, add photos, set pricing and availability.
help.cat1Q2: Can I edit my listing after publishing?
help.cat1A2: Yes. From your hosting dashboard, go to Listings, click your property, then "Edit listing". Changes are live immediately.
help.cat1Q3: How do I add or remove photos?
help.cat1A3: From the edit listing page, scroll to the Photos section. You can upload new photos, remove existing ones, or set a cover image.
help.cat2Q1: When do I receive my payout?
help.cat2A1: Payouts are processed after a guest checks in. Funds are typically available within 1–3 business days depending on your bank.
help.cat2A2: Oikivo charges a small service fee to cover platform costs. This is displayed transparently on each booking before confirmation.
help.cat2Q3: How do I request a manual payout?
help.cat2A3: From Hosting → Earnings, click "Request Payout". The minimum payout amount is EGP 100.
help.cat3Q1: How do I confirm or decline a reservation?
help.cat3A1: Go to Hosting → Reservations. Click on any pending booking to review guest details, then confirm or decline.
help.cat3A2: Yes. Guests can cancel according to your cancellation policy. Check the booking details page for the applicable policy.
help.cat3Q3: How do I block dates on my calendar?
help.cat3A3: From Hosting → Listings → your property → Calendar, click any date to block or unblock it.
help.cat4Q1: How do I message a guest?
help.cat4A1: From Hosting → Inbox, or from the reservation detail page, use the message thread to communicate with your guest.
help.cat4A2: Yes. Messages are only visible to you and the guest (or host) involved in the booking.
help.cat5A1: All users must verify their email. We also encourage hosts to require ID verification before accepting bookings.
help.cat5Q2: What if a guest damages my property?
help.cat5A2: Contact our support team within 48 hours of checkout with photos and a description. We will guide you through the resolution process.
help.cat6Q1: When can I leave a review?
help.cat6A1: You can leave a review for a guest within 14 days after checkout. Guests can also review their stay during this period.
help.cat6Q2: Can I respond to a review?
help.cat6A2: Yes. From your listing page, find the review and click "Respond". Your response is public and visible to all future guests.

safety.heroDesc: How Oikivo helps guests and hosts stay safe before, during, and after every trip.
safety.feature1Desc: All users must follow our community rules. We do not tolerate harassment, discrimination, fraud, violence, or unsafe property conditions. Accounts may be suspended for violations.
safety.feature2Desc: We use verified email, verified phone, and optional government ID checks. Hosts can require additional verification before accepting bookings. Always communicate and pay within Oikivo.
safety.feature3Desc: Payments are processed through encrypted channels. Never send money outside Oikivo — not via cash, direct bank transfers, or external payment links shared in messages.
safety.feature4Desc: For emergencies, contact local emergency services first. For non-emergency incidents, report in-app with photos, timestamps, and details. Our team investigates all reports.
safety.feature5Desc: Need help during a trip? Contact support from the Help Center or Contact page. We prioritize urgent safety cases and can coordinate next-step guidance quickly.
safety.check1: Review listing photos, amenities, and house rules before booking.
safety.check2: Check host reviews and response rate.
safety.check3: Message the host in-app if anything is unclear before arrival.
safety.check4: At check-in, confirm emergency exits and safety equipment.
safety.check5: Report any hazards immediately through the in-app support channel.

cancellation.heroDesc: How cancellations, refunds, and exceptions are handled on Oikivo.
cancellation.overviewDesc: Hosts choose a cancellation policy for each listing. The active policy is shown on the listing page and in the checkout summary before a guest confirms payment.
cancellation.guestDesc: Guests can cancel from the Trips page. Refund eligibility depends on timing and the listing's policy tier:
cancellation.guestCta: Go to My Trips to cancel a booking
cancellation.hostWarning: Host cancellations may trigger penalties, impact listing ranking, and reduce trust with future guests.
cancellation.hostDesc: When a host cancels a confirmed booking, the guest is eligible for a full refund and will receive assistance finding an alternative stay.
cancellation.refundDesc: Approved refunds are usually issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. Bank processing times may vary depending on your payment provider and card issuer.
cancellation.exceptionsDesc: In certain verified cases — major travel disruptions, government travel restrictions, or serious safety issues — Oikivo may apply special handling beyond the standard policy. Supporting documentation is required to qualify.
cancellation.supportDesc: For cancellation support, visit the Help Center or Contact Us page. Include your booking ID, the timeline of events, and any supporting evidence for faster resolution.

privacy.heroDesc: How Oikivo collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
privacy.calloutDesc: We do not and will never sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.introDesc: At Oikivo, privacy is foundational. This policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you use our platform.
privacy.collectIntro: We collect information you provide directly and information generated through your use of our platform:
privacy.collectItem1: Account information (name, email, phone, profile photo)
privacy.collectItem3: Payment information (processed securely via Stripe or InstaPay)
privacy.collectItem4: Communications with hosts, guests, or our support team
privacy.collectItem6: Search queries and browsing history on our platform
privacy.collectItem7: Device and usage information (IP address, browser type, OS)
privacy.collectItem8: Location data (when permitted by your device settings)
privacy.useIntro: We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve our services:
privacy.useItem2: Verify your identity and prevent fraud
privacy.useItem3: Communicate about your reservations and account
privacy.useItem4: Personalize your search results and recommendations
privacy.useItem5: Send transactional emails and service updates
privacy.useItem7: Improve our products and develop new features
privacy.shareDesc: We never sell your data. We may share your information with hosts or guests to facilitate bookings, with payment processors (Stripe, InstaPay) to complete transactions, and with service providers who assist our operations under strict data-protection agreements. We may also share data to comply with legal requirements or to protect rights and safety.
privacy.cookiesDesc: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to operate our platform, remember your preferences, analyze usage, and enhance security. You can control cookies through your browser settings, though disabling certain cookies may affect functionality. We use three types: essential (required for the platform), functional (for personalization), and analytics (to improve our service).
privacy.securityDesc: We implement industry-standard security measures including TLS/SSL encryption in transit, encrypted storage for sensitive data, multi-factor authentication options, and regular security audits. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.rightsIntro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:
privacy.rightsItem1: Access a copy of your personal data
privacy.rightsItem3: Request deletion of your account and data
privacy.rightsItem5: Data portability — receive your data in a structured format
privacy.rightsItem6: Lodge a complaint with a data protection authority
privacy.contactDesc: For privacy questions or to exercise your rights, contact our Data Protection Officer at
privacy.contactAfterEmail: We will respond within 30 days of receiving your request.

terms.heroDesc: These terms form a binding agreement between you and Oikivo. Please read them carefully before using our platform.
terms.hostDividerDesc: The following sections apply specifically to users who list properties or experiences on Oikivo as hosts. By creating a listing, you agree to all general terms above and these additional host-specific obligations.
terms.sec1Desc: By accessing or using Oikivo's website, mobile application, or any of our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, you may not use our services. These terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and Oikivo.
terms.sec2Desc1: Oikivo is an online marketplace connecting travelers with hosts offering accommodations and experiences across Egypt and the MENA region. We facilitate transactions but are not a party to any rental or service agreement between hosts and guests.
terms.sec2Desc2: You must be at least 18 years old to use our platform. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration and to keep your account updated at all times.
terms.sec3Item1: Maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials
terms.sec3Item2: All activities that occur under your account
terms.sec3Item3: Notifying us immediately of any unauthorized use
terms.sec3Item4: Ensuring your account information is accurate and up to date
terms.sec3Item5: Using strong, unique passwords for your account
terms.sec4Desc1: When you book through Oikivo, you agree to pay all fees associated with your booking — including accommodation fees, cleaning fees, service fees, and applicable taxes. Payment is processed securely at the time of booking.
terms.sec4Desc2: Hosts set their own pricing. Oikivo charges a service fee on each booking to cover platform costs, customer support, and payment processing. All fees are displayed before you confirm.
terms.sec5Desc1: Cancellation policies vary by listing and are set by individual hosts. The applicable policy is displayed on each listing page and during checkout.
terms.sec5Desc2: If you cancel a booking, any refund will be processed according to the cancellation policy in effect at the time of booking. Oikivo may offer resolution support in cases of disputes.
terms.sec6Item1: Use our platform for any illegal purpose
terms.sec6Item2: Circumvent our payment system or pay outside Oikivo
terms.sec6Item3: Post false, misleading, or fraudulent listings or reviews
terms.sec6Item4: Harass, threaten, or harm other users
terms.sec6Item5: Use automated tools to scrape or abuse our platform
terms.sec6Item7: Discriminate based on race, religion, nationality, gender, or other protected characteristics
terms.sec7Desc1: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Oikivo is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages — including loss of profits, data, or goodwill.
terms.sec7Desc2: Our liability to you for any cause shall be limited to the amount you paid Oikivo in the 12 months preceding the incident.
terms.sec8Desc: We may update these Terms at any time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or a notice on our platform. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance. Questions?
terms.sec9Desc1: By listing a property or experience on Oikivo, you enter into a separate host agreement with the platform. As a host, you act as an independent provider — Oikivo is not a co-host, property manager, or party to your rental contracts.
terms.sec9Desc2: You are solely responsible for compliance with all applicable Egyptian laws and regulations, including property licensing, rental legality, health and safety standards, and tax obligations on rental income. Oikivo does not verify legal compliance on your behalf.
terms.sec10Intro: Your listing must accurately represent your space at all times. You agree to:
terms.sec10Item1: Provide honest, up-to-date descriptions, photos, and pricing — including all fees (cleaning, deposit)
terms.sec10Item2: List only spaces you are legally authorized to rent
terms.sec10Item3: Keep your maximum guest count, bedroom count, and amenity list accurate
terms.sec10Item4: Disclose any known safety hazards or property limitations
terms.sec10Item5: Respond to booking requests within 24 hours
terms.sec10Item6: Honor confirmed bookings — cancelling confirmed bookings without cause may result in penalties
terms.sec10Item7: Maintain the property in a clean, safe, and habitable condition for every guest
terms.sec10Warning: Listings found to contain false or misleading information may be suspended or permanently removed without notice.
terms.sec11BoxTitle: 0% host commission — you keep 100% of your nightly rate.
terms.sec11BoxDesc: Oikivo does not deduct a commission from host earnings. A separate service fee is charged directly to guests on top of your listed price. You always receive the full amount you set.
terms.sec11PayoutItem1: Payouts are released after guest check-in, typically within 1–3 business days
terms.sec11PayoutItem2: You are responsible for providing accurate payout account details (Instapay, bank transfer, or other supported methods)
terms.sec11PayoutItem3: Oikivo is not liable for delays caused by incorrect payout information you provide
terms.sec11PayoutItem4: If a booking is cancelled by the guest and a refund is issued under the applicable cancellation policy, your payout will be reduced accordingly
terms.sec11PayoutItem5: Any dispute deductions (e.g., admin-mediated refunds) will be deducted from the relevant payout
terms.sec12Desc1: As a host, you are responsible for keeping your calendar availability accurate at all times. Double-bookings caused by an out-of-date calendar are your responsibility and may result in penalties.
terms.sec12BoxItem1: Block dates on Oikivo whenever the property is unavailable on any other platform (Airbnb, Booking.com, etc.)
terms.sec12BoxItem2: Use the iCal / calendar sync feature to link your external calendars and prevent conflicts
terms.sec12BoxItem3: Update your calendar within 24 hours of any external booking
terms.sec12Desc2: If you cancel a confirmed booking due to a calendar conflict, Oikivo may apply a cancellation penalty, remove your listing from search results temporarily, or suspend your hosting account in cases of repeated violations.
terms.sec13Desc1: If you enable a security deposit on your listing, you agree to the following rules. The deposit is a
terms.sec13Desc2: — no money is charged or held by Oikivo. You collect the deposit in cash from the guest at check-in or check-out.
terms.sec13Item1: You must inform the guest of the deposit amount and collection timing before check-in
terms.sec13Item2: If no damage occurs, you must return the cash deposit to the guest promptly after checkout
terms.sec13Item3: If damage occurs, you may submit a damage claim through your reservations dashboard within 48 hours of checkout
terms.sec13Item4: Claims must include a written description of the damage and up to 10 supporting evidence photos
terms.sec13Item5: You may edit or cancel your claim at any time before admin review
terms.sec13Item6: Oikivo admin will review your claim and issue a decision — approved (you keep the deposit) or rejected (you must return it within 48 hours)
terms.sec13Item7: Admin decisions are final. Misuse of the deposit claim system may result in account suspension
terms.sec13Warning: Refusing to return a rejected deposit to a guest is a violation of these terms and may result in permanent account suspension and referral to relevant authorities.
terms.sec14Intro: Oikivo expects all hosts to treat guests with respect and professionalism. You agree to:
terms.sec14Item1: Communicate respectfully and promptly with guests at all times
terms.sec14Item2: Not discriminate against guests based on nationality, religion, gender, disability, or any other protected characteristic
terms.sec14Item3: Not retaliate against guests for leaving honest reviews
terms.sec14Item4: Not offer or solicit off-platform payments to circumvent Oikivo fees
terms.sec14Item5: Respect guest privacy — do not install hidden cameras or recording devices in private areas
terms.sec14Item6: Not engage in fraudulent activity including fake reviews, inflated pricing, or bait-and-switch listing descriptions
terms.sec14Desc: Violations of host conduct standards are reviewed by the Oikivo trust & safety team. Penalties range from listing suspension to permanent account termination depending on severity. Questions or concerns?

accessibility.heroDesc: Oikivo is committed to making our website and booking experience usable for everyone.
accessibility.sec1Desc: We are working toward conformance with WCAG 2.1 level AA principles: perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust experiences across web and mobile platforms.
accessibility.sec2Item1: Keyboard-friendly navigation for core flows such as search and booking.
accessibility.sec2Item2: Semantic page structure with headings and landmarks.
accessibility.sec2Item3: Readable text contrast in primary interface components.
accessibility.sec2Item4: Visible focus indicators for interactive controls.
accessibility.sec2Item5: Support for RTL layout in Arabic locale.
accessibility.sec3Desc: Hosts are encouraged to provide accessibility information such as step-free entry, elevator access, doorway widths, and bathroom accessibility features to help guests make informed decisions.
accessibility.sec4Desc: Some third-party integrations and user-generated content may not yet provide full accessibility support. We continuously review these areas and prioritize fixes based on impact.
accessibility.sec5Desc: If you encounter any accessibility barriers, contact us through the Contact page and include the page URL, issue description, and your preferred contact method.
accessibility.sec6Desc: We run recurring audits, improve component accessibility, and address critical issues as part of our regular release cycle.

egyptRegulations.pageIntro: Everything you need to know about the Holiday Home License introduced by the Ministry of Tourism & Antiquities (MoTA) under Decrees No. 209/2025 and No. 801/2025.
egyptRegulations.complianceAlert: Compliance required as of the effective date of Decree No. 209/2025
egyptRegulations.overview1: Egypt's Ministry of Tourism & Antiquities issued Decree No. 209 of 2025 and supplementary Decree No. 801 of 2025, establishing a formal licensing framework for Holiday Homes — privately owned or rented residential units offered to tourists for short-term stays.
egyptRegulations.overview2: Prior to these decrees, short-term rental activity in Egypt operated in a legal grey area. The new framework brings Egypt in line with international best practice and gives both hosts and guests clear rights and responsibilities.
egyptRegulations.overview3: Any host listing a property for short-term rental use in Egypt must obtain a Holiday Home License from MoTA before accepting bookings. Failure to comply may result in significant fines and administrative action.
egyptRegulations.card1Desc: Renting out your own apartment for stays of fewer than 90 consecutive days
egyptRegulations.card2Desc: North Coast, Red Sea, or Nile-facing properties offered on a nightly or weekly basis
egyptRegulations.card3Desc: If your lease permits, you must still obtain a Holiday Home License in your name
egyptRegulations.req1: Unit must meet minimum furnishing and safety standards defined by MoTA
egyptRegulations.req2: Fire extinguisher and smoke detector must be installed
egyptRegulations.req3: First-aid kit must be available on the premises
egyptRegulations.req4: Host must keep a guest register for each stay
egyptRegulations.req5: Occupancy may not exceed the approved capacity stated in the license
egyptRegulations.req7: Tourism Tax (if applicable) must be collected and remitted to the Tax Authority
egyptRegulations.howToApplyTitle: How to Apply — Step by Step
egyptRegulations.step1Desc: Create an account on the Ministry of Tourism & Antiquities (MoTA) official portal (mota.gov.eg) and navigate to the Holiday Home License section.
egyptRegulations.step2Desc: National ID (or passport for non-Egyptians), property title deed or notarised lease agreement, engineering survey certificate, building permit, property insurance certificate, and a recent utility bill.
egyptRegulations.step3Desc: Upload all documents through the portal and pay the registration fee. Fees vary by unit type and number of rooms; currently set by MoTA at administrative cost.
egyptRegulations.step4Desc: A MoTA inspector may visit the property to verify compliance with safety and furnishing standards. Approval is typically issued within 30 working days.
egyptRegulations.step5Desc: Once approved, display the license number on all advertisements and booking platforms — including your listing on this platform.
egyptRegulations.penalty1: Fine of EGP 10,000–100,000 + potential unit seizure
egyptRegulations.penalty3: Fine of EGP 5,000–20,000 + suspension of license
egyptRegulations.penalty5: Permanent license revocation & referral to prosecution
egyptRegulations.whyLicenseTitle: Why Licensing Protects You as a Host
egyptRegulations.whyPoint1: Gives you legal standing in case of disputes with guests or neighbours
egyptRegulations.whyPoint2: Enables you to collect Tourism Tax and issue official receipts
egyptRegulations.whyPoint3: Qualifies your listing for premium visibility on booking platforms
egyptRegulations.whyPoint4: Demonstrates credibility to guests and increases booking conversion
egyptRegulations.whyPoint5: Protects against administrative closure or seizure of your property
egyptRegulations.disclaimer: Disclaimer: This page is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. Regulations may change; always consult the official MoTA portal or a qualified Egyptian lawyer for up-to-date guidance specific to your situation.
